Hi Hannah / Redwood team —

Thanks for the quick intro last week. CloudyHealth is seeing a batch of GCP-led opportunities where the customers have asked for low-latency LLM inference and are evaluating deployment models (hosted vs dedicated). We think there are 4 overlapping deals that would benefit from a short joint pipeline stitch and handshake between the GCP field, CloudyHealth, and Redwood.

Proposed intent for the session:
- Surface overlapping opportunities and owners
- Agree on primary co-sell motion (GCP-funded PoC, listing + marketplace credits, or referral)
- Decide who will own next steps and any required paperwork (SOW/PoC order)

Attached is a quick extract of the opportunities we see from our side. I also dropped a sandbox sheet with account notes: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1GcpPipelineStitchExample

Attachments: [Attachment: gcp-opps-extract.csv (CSV, 34 KB)]

Would anyone on the Redwood PM side be available for a 30–45 minute sync next week (Tue/Wed preferred)? Miguel

Thanks Miguel — this is helpful.

We should definitely run a focused stitch to align owners and avoid duplication. Suggested agenda (30–40m):
1) Quick intros + confirmation of decision makers (5m)
2) Walk the 4 accounts / hypothesis for co-sell motion (15m)
3) Prioritization and immediate next steps (10m)
4) Action owners & timeline (5m)

Ben — can you bring an updated view of the joint marketplace options and any committed discounts we can offer for PoCs? Laura — please bring the SLA/rollout constraints we need for Dedicated offers. Vanessa — can you confirm regional coverage for those accounts (most are US but one is EU).

I attached our latest quick-playbook for GCP partner motions — it outlines typical handoffs and what we ask the field for at each stage. Pre-read would help but not required.

Proposed times: Tue 11/24 10:00–10:45 PT or Wed 11/25 11:00–11:45 PT. Miguel / Priya — which works?

Quick notes from my side — thanks for pulling this together.
- For PoCs: we can offer 30% marketplace credit for first 3 months on Hosted API, or a trial Dedicated window (2–4 weeks) depending on throughput needs.
- Need to know expected QPS and avg token lengths to recommend Dedicated vs Hosted. If any account has strict data residency, Dedicated or Private will be required.
- I'll prep a 1-slide summary of pricing levers and a short matrix tying co-sell motion -> recommended product path.

I can do Tues 11/24 10:00 PT. If Priya/Miguel prefer Wed, I can pivot.
